zygisk_provider.policy: Exactly one effective module-based provider is allowed. Zero module providers are reported unresolved because Magisk built-in Zygisk is outside module-tree discovery; physical qualification must bind the actual provider explicitly.

zygisk-detach.config_format: length-prefixed alternating-byte package names as implemented by reviewed CLI

runtime_non_targets: Protected BKI/Ash strict exclusions remain outside this runtime observer inventory and are bound only by host/physical qualification evidence.
